title: Tiny Sentence Workshop
shareTitle: Tiny Sentence Workshop — Read It, Build It, See It
description: Press tiny clay word stamps into short decodable sentences, read them from left to right, and wake up the matching miniature scene.
learningGoals: Track and decode controlled short-vowel sentences from left to right
Reconstruct a short sentence in meaningful word order
Match a printed sentence to its literal pictured meaning
interactionModel: custom DOM clay workshop with sequential word taps, tap-or-drag sentence assembly, and three-way authored scene choice across three-round sessions
feedbackModel: Every accepted word speaks and presses into place; mistakes wobble gently and preserve progress; each complete strip reads aloud and wakes its clay scene; three strips fill a reward shelf.
credits: Kaigani; claymation production art made with GPT Image 2 and approved local Qwen workflows; platform teacher narration made with Qwen voice clone and Whisper QA. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
